title: P2: remediate product lint findings revealed by complete measurement
body: The complete diagnostic run with DEVAI PR #413 parsed 3498 files and reported 1135 errors and 1 warning, with zero parser errors. Existing app rules are preserved; enablement changes configure discovery and parser roots only. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/remediation-599161f9/evidence-manifest.json and candidate-provider diagnostics. Owner: Engineer; fix product violations in a separate PR without weakening or disabling rules. Do not classify these as enablement regressions merely because the previous sensor could not complete; compare each finding with its source history. The diagnostic is not an official published-provider verdict.
